quarterly_data.quarter: Credo press release: Credo Unveils 1.6T ZeroFlap Active Light Cable, Industry's (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Credo shared details of its 1.6T ZeroFlap active light cable (ALC), which it calls the industry's first row-scale, wide-parallel optical interconnect for AI scale-out and front-end networks; it will be shipping in 2027. The ALC uses a dense array of micro-emitters and photodetectors with flexible fiber bundles, splitting 200G lanes into many low-rate optical channels with simple NRZ modulation (no DSP-based signal processing). It is designed to draw 12W per cable-end in a pluggable form factor - roughly 30% less than comparable active electrical cables (AECs) - is 10x lighter than AECs, targets reach up to 50m and a reliability of 100 million hours MTBF, with built-in channel redundancy and ZeroFlap link monitoring for hitless failover. The architecture is featured at Credo's OCP Global Summit booth.
